page.overview:
Who is Barbara Mawdsley?

M, known privately as Barbara Mawdsley is the head of MI6 in the continuity of the Raymond Benson James Bond novels.

In one of the only plot points that carried over from John Gardner's COLD, Sir Miles Messervy had retired from MI6, and Mawdsley took his place as M.

Following the events of High Time to Kill, as well as Bond's various mental and physical issues following the incident, M determines that Bond is not in condition to carry out his assignments. Despite so, Bond continues his investigations to Union and the death of Helena Marksbury. Bond eventually discovers existence of two Union members Michael Clayton and Walter van Breeschooten, who are due to Tangier, but she still reprimands Bond for continuing investigations, which Bond is too weak and personally involved to carry out.

She turns out to be partly right, as Bond has been gamed by The Union this entire time. They murder Dr. Kimberly Feare and frame Bond, who had fainted again, for it.
